videos.title: The 80% of UI Design - Typography
videos.why: Sajid's method for choosing font size, weight and colour for interface text, built on the point that most of a UI is type; compare his sizes with the scale you build in lab-type-scale.

videos.title: The right Line Length & Line Height in Typography
videos.why: Line length from 2:22 and line height from 4:37, including why headings need tighter line height (7:37); note he lands on 60 to 80 characters for desktop reading, a little wider than the 45 to 75 range in this lesson.

podcasts.episode: Episode 268: UI Typography with Oliver Schöndorfer
podcasts.why: The Pimp my Type designer on choosing a typeface for a software product and why small details matter so much in product typography; useful background for lab-pairing.

reads.title: Typography in ten minutes
reads.why: Five rules that start with making the body text look good first, then size (15 to 25 pixels on the web), line spacing, line length and font choice; the fastest useful page on type.

reads.title: Typography
reads.why: Google's scale of named styles from Display Large to Label Small, with the reminder that no single product uses all of them; a model for naming your own sizes by role instead of by pixel value.

reads.title: Typography
reads.why: Apple's default and minimum text sizes for each platform (17 pt and 11 pt on iPhone), plus advice to avoid light weights and to keep the number of typefaces small.
